shellCommands.command:
PORT=3111 node index.js > /tmp/app.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
cat /tmp/app.log
echo "--- add two books ---"
curl -s -i -X POST localhost:3111/books --data-urlencode "title=Dune" --data-urlencode "author=Frank Herbert" --data-urlencode "notes=The spice must flow." | head -3
curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST localhost:3111/books --data-urlencode "title=Piranesi" --data-urlencode "author=Susanna Clarke"
echo "--- home page ---"
curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -E 'href="/books|Currently reading|Finished|empty'

cd /workspace
echo "--- mark Dune finished from the shelf ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST localhost:3111/books/dune-3435d6/finish --data "return=/"
curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -A3 -E '<h2>(Currently reading|Finished)'
echo "--- shareable book link ---"
curl -s localhost:3111/books/dune-3435d6 | grep -E '<title>|<h1>|by |Finished |spice'
echo "--- notes update, then persistence across restart ---"
curl -s -i -X POST localhost:3111/books/piranesi-abf869/notes --data-urlencode "notes=Halls and statues." | grep -i location
cat data/books.json

cd /workspace
pkill -f "node index.js"; sleep 0.5
PORT=3112 node index.js > /tmp/app2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
echo "--- after restart ---"
curl -s localhost:3112/ | grep -c 'class="title"'
curl -s localhost:3112/books/dune-3435d6 | grep '<h1>'
pkill -f "node index.js"; sleep 0.3
rm -rf data
git status --short

cd /workspace
PORT=3113 node index.js > /tmp/app3.log 2>&1 &
APP=$!
sleep 1
echo "books listed after restart: $(curl -s localhost:3113/ | grep -c 'class="title"')"
curl -s localhost:3113/books/dune-3435d6 | grep '<h1>'
kill $APP; wait $APP 2>/dev/null
echo "exit: server stopped"
rm -rf data && grep -n "data" .gitignore || echo "(data not ignored)"
npm test 2>&1 | tail -6 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -2 && git status --short
